title: 贝恩资本John：香港市场成退出关键，能源转型项目能否破局？
speaker: John Connaughton

segments.en: No, I think it's a great question, and it changes all the time.
segments.zh: 不，我觉得这是个好问题，而且情况一直在变。

segments.en: I mean, we've been very active investors in energy transition.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，我们在能源转型领域一直非常活跃。

segments.en: We have this really interesting renewable energy company that was located in China, but then we built a plant in Malaysia.
segments.zh: 我们有一家很有意思的可再生能源公司，原本在中国，后来在马来西亚建了厂。

segments.en: It's a pan-Asian strategy, and we're going to take it public, I hope.
segments.zh: 这是泛亚洲策略，我们希望把它推向公开市场。

segments.en: But that type of story is something that's very attractive to us.
segments.zh: 但这类故事对我们非常有吸引力。

segments.en: Historically, we've also done a lot of health care in life sciences.
segments.zh: 从历史上看，我们在医疗健康和生命科学领域也做了很多。

segments.en: So the question will be, will the investable assets be there with some security to say what the policies as they shift will they make it uninvestable?
segments.zh: 所以问题是，可配置的资产是否会存在，并且有一定保障，说明政策变化不会让它变得不可配置？

segments.en: Yeah, can I just ask you two about, you mentioned Hong Kong, you're looking to take two companies public here.
segments.zh: 好的，我能问你们两位吗？你们提到香港，打算让两家公司在这里上市。

segments.en: The market hasn't really done well in terms of just on an index level.
segments.zh: 市场在指数层面表现并不太好。

segments.en: Yeah, correct. What's the conversation you're having? How is that like?
segments.zh: 对，没错。你们在谈些什么？情况怎么样？

segments.en: Are you looking to get that out this year? Or I think we, I think we may be able to, we have two.
segments.zh: 你们打算今年推出吗？我觉得我们可能可以，我们有两个。

segments.en: Yes, one of them is this renewable energy, which I think has a lot of attractive following.
segments.zh: 是的，其中一个就是可再生能源，我认为它很有吸引力。

segments.en: But as to whether we get it out successfully, you're right, the market has not been as favorable as one would hope.
segments.zh: 但能否成功推出，你说得对，市场并不像人们希望的那么有利。

segments.en: But I think for us, it's not about the company's going to do great.
segments.zh: 但对我们来说，关键不是公司会表现很好。

segments.en: The timing of this year versus first quarter, I think that's not as important to us as just knowing that that Hong Kong market continues to develop.
segments.zh: 今年还是第一季度的时机，对我们来说不如香港市场持续发展重要。

segments.en: That's one of the big, you talked about filters for China investment.
segments.zh: 这是你谈到的中国**筛选标准之一。

segments.en: One of the questions is exits. And exits has been the hardest thing for anybody who owns assets in China.
segments.zh: 问题之一是退出。对于在中国持有资产的人来说，退出是最困难的。

segments.en: So a robust Hong Kong market, or at least a better Hong Kong market, I think will be very attractive.
segments.zh: 因此，一个强劲的香港市场，或者至少一个更好的香港市场，将非常有吸引力。
